_comment: Cross-language parity vectors for internal/integrations/google, the Google
integration's in-process MCP server. Generated from Go, then frozen. Read by
Unlike the other five integrations, Google's requests are built by generated
client libraries rather than by the handlers, so these recordings are the only
written specification of what goes on the wire — see the test file's header.
'tools' and 'hosting' come from live tools/list calls against servers built by
google.Start; 'calls' and 'refreshes' from live tools/call calls against a
scripted fake Google that records every request each tool built.
The client secret, refresh token and access token are fixtures, not secrets:
they are recorded because the refresh request body is a parity surface.
X-Goog-Api-Client and User-Agent are deliberately not recorded (they embed the
Go toolchain version) and neither is the random multipart boundary.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Creates a new event on the user's primary Google Calendar.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Creates a new file in Google Drive with the provided content.

name.description: required,Name of the file to create

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Downloads and returns the text content of a Google Drive file by its ID.

file_id.description: required,The Google Drive file ID to download

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: Lists files and folders in Google Drive.

max_results.description: Maximum number of files to return (default 10, max 100)

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Reads the full content of a Gmail message by its ID.

message_id.description: required,The Gmail message ID to read

tools.name: search_email
tools.description: Searches Gmail messages using Gmail query syntax (e.g. 'from:alice@example.com is:unread').

max_results.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 10, max 50)

body.description: required,Plain text body of the email

tools.name: view_events
tools.description: Lists events from the user's primary Google Calendar within an optional time range.

max_results.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 10, max 100)

time_max.description: Upper bound for event start time in RFC3339 format.

time_min.description: Lower bound for event end time in RFC3339 format. Defaults to now.

hosting.case: every service enabled with no tool list — an empty allowed set hosts everything
one service enabled hosts only its tools
a disabled service contributes neither its gate nor its names
one tool named under one service narrows every enabled service
a name contributed by one service admits a tool belonging to another
an enabled but unknown service still narrows the ones that exist
a tool named by a disabled service is not allowed anywhere

refreshes.case: a token an hour from expiry is reused without a refresh
a token with no expiry never refreshes
a token five seconds from expiry refreshes inside the delta
an expired token refreshes and the new access token reaches the request
a refused refresh surfaces as the tool's own failure
